messages:
nina: quick sync — we're starting a soft deprecation of v1 next wednesday. goal: route 80% of traffic to v2 by EOW with canaries + telemetry checks. want to align console UX + client library guidance so customers don't panic.

samir: +1. what's the exact signal that will flip canary -> ramp? latency delta? error spike? model/response diffs?

nina: primary: error rate + 95p latency. secondary: output regression score from our eval infra (prompt-set based). if eval fails we pause and auto-roll back.

leo: add quota / token accounting check too. if clients hit unexpected token spikes after switching, we should surface a banner and offer auto-revert.

dina: for client libs we need a compatibility shim: keep v1 endpoints but attach `x-client-version` header, and emit `version_mismatch` telemetry. docs + changelog entry.

ux-anna: from UX side: propose two console affordances — (1) per-customer deprecations timeline panel, (2) in-place 'Try v2' button with side-by-side diff preview. also a small toast when a customer's routes are switched.

samir: thumbs on telemetry: we need event names and sampling. suggest `api.version.routed` (every request), `api.version.eval_regression` (when eval flag tripped), `api.version.quota_alert` (when token delta > 2x baseline). sample `api.version.routed` at 0.1 for orgs > 100k tokens/day.

leo: routing policy detail — sticky by `client_id` for 10m after first hit. fallback order: v2 -> v1-readonly -> v1. This prevents noisy switching for streaming sessions.

dina: client lib note: change log sample code: ```python
# automatic fallback included
client = Redwood(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_KEY'))
client.set_preference('prefer_version', 'v2')
```
Make sure we ship patch release and signal via registry.

ux-anna: small UX ask: show the active routing policy per-route in the console routes table (tiny pill: sticky/round-robin). saves support tickets.

samir: ops runbook snippet: on regression alert -> 1) pause rollout 2) set routing to v1 for affected orgs 3) capture sample requests + send to eval team 4) open incident channel with prefilled template. Deploy-bot can automate steps 1/2.

deploy-bot: automation ready — `/deploy rollback --routes v1 --filter orgs=REGRESSION` will toggle routing and emit `deploy.rollback` event. requires `eng-ops` approval.

nina: thanks. action items: samir define telemetry events + rates by EOD, leo update routing service with sticky TTL + fallback order, dina publish client-lib patch + migration guide, ux-anna mock console panels. we'll dry-run on staging friday. :thumbsup:

leo: dev note — watch for cached kv entries in edge caches when we flip. need to invalidate prefix `route_v*` per-org.

samir: will add telemetry dashboards: error rate by version, latency P50/P95 by version, token delta by org. alert thresholds: error rate +1.5% absolute or latency P95 +200ms.

dina: I'll draft the migration paragraph: short, code snippets, recommended rollout steps (canary 5% -> 25% -> 80%), rollback instructions, and FAQ. ping me for wording.

ux-anna: I'll prototype the side-by-side diff in the console with a minimal sample prompt and ability to flag regressions.

nina: excellent. we'll reconvene after staging run. dropping a checklist in the thread so support/solutions can pick it up.

support checklist (nina): 1) update canned responses 2) add console banner template 3) prepare org-specific advisory emails 4) monitor `api.version.routed` dashboard.

leo: one more — ensure quota billing doesn't double-count when requests are proxied between v2/v1 during fallback.

samir: noted. will coordinate with billing infra.

deploy-bot: reminder scheduled: staging dry-run at 2025-05-02T15:00Z.

nina: thanks all.
